coalitions.name: Vermont Environmental Common Agenda
coalitions.description: Annual shared legislative agenda issued by Vermont Conservation Voters and 21 partner organizations covering democracy, resilient communities, transportation, food security, toxic-free communities and affordable clean energy. The 2026 edition (22 partners) came out Jan 14, 2026.

projects.name: 2026 Environmental Common Agenda
projects.description: Six shared priorities for the 2026 legislative session: protect democracy, build resilient communities, transportation solutions, food security, toxic-free communities and affordable clean energy.

coalitions.name: #ActOnClimateVT
coalitions.description: Coalition of 30+ Vermont organizations that says it builds support for equitable, just climate solutions and credits itself with helping pass the 2020 Global Warming Solutions Act. coalitions.name: Transportation for Vermonters
coalitions.description: Cross-sector coalition convened by VNRC pushing for a sustainable, accessible, affordable transportation system in a rural state; launched in Nov 2017 and still testifying to the legislature in Feb 2026.

coalitions.name: Vermont Clean Communities (Clean Cities Coalition)

organizations.name: Vermont Natural Resources Council

notes: METHOD: WebSearch/WebFetch plus plain curl for sites whose robots.txt allows crawlers; I did not read sites whose robots.txt blocks AI crawlers or that return 403/429 (350vermont.org, vecan.net committee pages, actonclimatevt.org, t4vt.org, vctn.org, hungerfreevt.org, marshfieldvt.gov, addisonindependent.com). For those, facts come from search-result titles, snippets or partner pages and are marked as such. COALITIONS WITH NO PUBLIC MEMBER LIST: #ActOnClimateVT (site says 30+ organizations, names none; the 2019 and 2020 platform signer lists on VNRC/VPIRG pages predate the brand and are not used). PARTIAL MEMBER LISTS: T4VT lists 14 members; 13 are linked and the 14th, Vermont Clean Cities Coalition, is modelled as the separate coalition vt_clean_communities_coalition. Energy Action Network (200+ members; only 28 nonprofit members linked), Vermont Clean Communities (about 80 stakeholders, 7 linked), VECAN (100+ committees; its map is interactive, so only the 4 named supporting orgs and one committee page seen in search results are linked). NOT INCLUDED: Energy Independent Vermont (VPIRG-run carbon-pricing coalition, 23 partners, page last modified May 2017; dormant), Vermont Renews (2021 Green New Deal-style coalition of RAD, 350VT, Sunrise, Migrant Justice, NOFA and others; no 2025-26 activity seen), Fair Share for Vermont and the 2026 Changemakers Summit co-sponsor group (tax and multi-issue, not climate-specific), Vermont Climate Council (state body), Vermont Climate Solutions Caucus (legislators), Vermont Interfaith Action (faith coalition whose own pages do not mention climate). ABSENT OR UNVERIFIABLE: Mothers Out Front (Vermont not found on the static local-teams page; the page may be script-rendered), Sunrise hubs (the sunrisemovement.org hub list is script-rendered; only an Action Network group page and an apparently dormant Sunrise Middlebury site were found; Middlebury not included because it showed no dates), 350Vermont local nodes, CCL Burlington/Upper Valley chapters (CCL's list shows only At Large and UVM), a state EJ coalition (none found; Rights & Democracy, Vermont Releaf Collective and CVOEO are the closest, and a 2022 EJ bill sign-on letter listed 33 groups including the Vermont Racial Justice Alliance and Rural EJOICE, which were not researched further). TOWN ENERGY COMMITTEES: only 4 included (Bennington, Charlotte, Middlebury, Marshfield) because they showed dated 2025-26 evidence; Richmond Climate Action Committee, Montpelier Energy Advisory Committee (not currently meeting) and others were rejected for staleness. Only Bennington was confirmed in VECAN's directory. COORDINATES: all lat/lng are town centres (geo_precision approx), including offices with street addresses. Orgs flagged remote have no verified location and sit on Montpelier. LAST_ACTIVITY: orgs seen only on a coalition membership list use 2026-10-01 (date the listing was read), which is not an activity date. Sunrise Vermont and Vermont Releaf Collective have last_activity null and inactive true because no dated activity was seen. DOUBTFUL: the Third Act (Oct 14, Unitarian Church of Montpelier) and VPIRG (Oct 14, 6 PM, Montpelier) events are probably the same event but neither page says so; Youth Lobby's 2026-03-12 date comes from a search-result title; Middlebury and Marshfield committee dates come from search listings; Third Act's Friday overpass actions through Nov 3 were reported only by a page summary and left out; WebFetch summaries (small model) were used for several lists, so spot-check the EAN, T4VT and Common Agenda member lists against the pages. Org 'type' is 'unknown' unless the source says 501c3/501c4, a faith group, government or an informal group. | REVIEW (Claude, 2026-10-01): last_activity blanked for orgs only seen on membership lists (was the research date). Spot-checked against live pages: Common Agenda partners (22/22), T4VT members, EAN membership sample (11/11), VNRC 10/7 event, VCV canvass 10/3 event: all matched.
